content:
covenants records funded reserve obligations. A COLLECTION_RETENTION covenant is already active.

A ROUTING_CONTINUITY covenant becomes active when a routing cutover is submitted. Accounts can require cutover_minimum_minor before submission.

Transferring principal below an ACTIVE covenant minimum before its until_minute is system-permitted, but immediately marks BREACHED and charges a nonrefundable 2000-cent fee. Restoring the balance later does not reverse the breach.

At until_minute, an unbreached covenant is RELEASED. Posted cash and fee-wallet cash are separate.
